records.text: Jon lost his job as a banker on January 19, 2023.
Jon plans to start his own dance studio after losing his banking job, motivated by his passion for dancing and desire to share the joy of dance with others.
Gina lost her job at DoorDash during January 2023.
Jon has been interested in dancing since childhood and considers dancing his passion and an escape.
Jon enjoys all dance styles, with contemporary dance as his favorite because he finds it expressive and powerful.
Gina uses dance as a primary way to relieve stress and especially likes contemporary dance because she finds it expressive and graceful and feels that it speaks to her.
Jon and Gina agreed to attend a dance class and explore new dance moves together.
Jon and Gina agreed to have a dance session on Friday, January 27, 2023, with Gina accepting Jon's invitation to see his dance moves.
On January 20, 2023, Jon shared a photograph showing a man in a suit performing a dance.
In 2022, Jon's dance crew won first place in a local dance competition. Jon described performing on stage as amazing and wants to share that intensity with other people.

Gina previously competed in several dance competitions and shows. Gina's favorite dance memory was winning first place with her team at a regional competition when Gina was fifteen; Gina remembers the achievement as an awesome feeling of accomplishment.
At the regional competition where Gina's team won first place, Gina's team performed a contemporary dance piece titled "Finding Freedom." Gina described the piece as emotional and powerful.
Gina shared a photograph showing a couple of people standing next to each other.
Gina shared a photograph of a large open porch with a fireplace and a view of the water.
Jon's ideal dance studio would be located by the water, with a room overlooking the ocean and several yoga mats; Jon shared a photo illustrating this ideal setup.
Jon hopes to find a dance-studio location like the ocean-view setup he shared because the view would inspire the dancers and studio community.
Before January 20, 2023, Jon rehearsed after work with a small group of dancers. The group practices many styles, including contemporary dance and hip-hop.
Jon and his small dance group were finishing choreography for a performance at a nearby festival planned for February 2023. Jon was excited about the project.
Jon shared a photograph of a group of dancers wearing white dresses while performing on a stage; the dancers are the group scheduled to perform at the nearby festival.
Jon believes the dancers in his small dance group have practiced hard and will impress festival attendees with their grace and skill.
Jon is glad to be part of the small dance group preparing to perform at the nearby festival.

On 2023-01-29, Gina launched an advertising campaign for her clothing store to grow the business; she described starting the store and taking risks as scary but rewarding, and shared a photo of the store displaying a variety of clothes.
Gina feels excited and fulfilled seeing her clothing-store vision become reality.

As of 2023-01-29, Jon was still searching for the ideal location for his dance studio and had found a downtown place with excellent natural light; he was imagining how the space could look before deciding.
Jon said he visited Paris on 2023-01-28 and enjoyed the trip; he shared a photo showing a bathroom with a blue floor and a pink wall.
Gina has visited Rome once but had never visited Paris as of 2023-01-29.
Before choosing a dance-studio location, Jon intends to check the space's size and floor quality and wants a dance floor with enough bounce for safe dancing by Jon and his students.

Jon prefers Marley flooring for his dance studio because it provides grip while allowing movement, is durable, and is easy to clean; Gina agreed that Marley flooring offers a suitable balance of grip and movement and helps make dancing safer and more enjoyable.
Jon described finding the right studio location and preparing the studio as exciting and nerve-wracking, but he is determined to succeed and believes the effort will be worthwhile.

On 2023-01-29, Gina encouraged Jon to believe in himself, persist with the dance-studio process, take breaks, and dance to relieve stress; Jon said he was glad to have Gina supporting him and planned to make time to dance and vent.
Jon and Gina expressed mutual optimism and determination about pursuing their goals, saying that success was near and that good things were ahead.
Jon is continuing to pursue his passion for dance despite setbacks and is still searching for a location to open a dance studio.

On February 1, 2023, Gina received a positive reply from a wholesaler she had emailed, making her very happy because the partnership will help her expand her clothing store and get closer to her customers.
On February 1, 2023, Gina shared a photo of a shopping mall with a glass entrance and a sign, showing the location associated with her clothing-store expansion.
On February 1, 2023, Jon told Gina that she had found the perfect spot for her store and that her hard work was paying off.
On February 1, 2023, Jon shared a photo of a room with a mirror and a wooden floor while discussing Gina's store location.

On February 1, 2023, Gina said she had designed the clothing-store space to feel cozy and inviting, so customers could browse trendy pieces; she shared a photo showing a clothing store with many garments on display.

Jon and Gina are friends/acquaintances speaking on 2023-02-01. Jon remains determined to open a dance studio despite a bumpy path and is still searching for a location. Gina received a positive wholesaler reply on 2023-02-01, enabling her to expand her clothing store and get closer to customers. Gina showed a shopping mall with a glass entrance and sign, and a designed clothing-store space that is cozy, inviting, and filled with trendy clothes; Jon praised her progress. Jon also shared a room photo with a mirror and wooden floor. Gina owns the clothing store, launched an ad campaign on 2023-01-29, and finds the venture scary but rewarding.

On February 1, 2023, Gina said she designed her clothing store's furniture and decor to reflect her personal style and make customers feel cozy. She chose furniture that is both attractive and comfortable, and added a chandelier for a glamorous look that matches the store's style.
Gina wants her clothing store to feel comfortable, inviting, and like a cool oasis, creating a memorable customer experience that encourages shoppers to return.

Jon believes that creating a special customer experience is important for making shoppers feel welcome and encouraging them to come back, and he believes Gina can create the store environment she imagines.
Gina said building her clothing store is difficult, but she is willing to face the challenge and believes her hard work and effort can create a special shopping experience.

Jon consistently supports Gina's clothing-store venture and encouraged her to keep creating something great; Gina reciprocally supports Jon's dance-studio plans and encouraged him to stay positive and keep going.
Jon said he is staying positive and pushing forward with his dance-studio plans, and that he and Gina have put their hearts into their dreams and can succeed.
Gina believes that staying motivated and continuing to work hard will eventually pay off, and she expressed confidence that she and Jon can achieve their respective dreams.
On February 4, 2023, Gina said her clothing store was doing great but described running it as a wild ride.
On February 4, 2023, Jon said he was working hard on his business despite obstacles and was determined to make it happen.
Jon is searching for a suitable location for his dance studio and considers finding the right spot difficult, but he remains determined and believes other pieces will follow once he finds it.
Jon is developing new dance routines and rehearsing intensively for an upcoming show.
Jon said dancing is his passion and brings him substantial joy and fulfillment.
On February 4, 2023, Jon shared a photo showing a woman in a gray dress performing a dance trick.
Jon is preparing for a dance competition near him planned for March 2023, where he hopes to demonstrate his skills and receive recognition from the dance community.
Jon is highly passionate about dancing and is excited about competing and sharing his skills with the dance community.

Gina strongly supports Jon's business and dance ambitions, encouraging him through setbacks and promising to be there for him; Jon appreciates Gina's support and says it helps him handle difficulties.
Gina believes Jon has the skills, passion, talent, and drive to succeed, and that his hard work will pay off in the dance competition and business ventures.
Jon intends to keep pursuing his dreams and not give up despite setbacks or circumstances not going his way.

On 2023-02-08, Jon told Gina that he had performed at the festival he previously mentioned; many people complimented Jon's dance moves, and the performance reminded Jon why dancing brings him joy and why he is passionate about it.
On 2023-02-08, Jon shared a photo showing a group of young girls in a dance studio.

On 2023-02-08, Jon said that he runs his own dance studio and values the freedom to create a space where dancers of all ages and skill levels can express themselves. Jon is thrilled to dance each day and finds it fulfilling to watch his students progress.

On 2023-02-08, Gina said that she had been working hard on her online clothing store and had partnered with a local artist to create distinctive designs. Gina shared a photo of a clothing rack displaying a coat and a dress.

Gina developed her new clothing designs after seeing an idea in a fashion magazine and noticing that few similar products were available. Gina collaborated with a local artist to make the designs, aiming to stay ahead of trends and offer customers something different.

Gina believes that taking risks is frightening but necessary for growth and is part of the journey to success. Jon agrees that taking risks are important for success and says risk-taking has helped him grow.
Jon left a secure 9-to-5 job as a banker to pursue a business based on his passion for dancing. Jon is determined to make the dance business work but acknowledges that starting it has been difficult.

Gina encouraged Jon not to become discouraged by the difficulties of starting his dance business and assured Jon that Gina is always available to support him. Jon said Gina's help means a lot and promised to keep working and remain optimistic.
On 2023-02-08, Jon shared a photograph of a cartoon character accompanied by a quote about fear.

Gina said a quote about fear helped her stay positive during difficult times, and Gina had the quote made into a tattoo as a reminder. Gina shared a photo of a woman standing on a balcony wearing a blue dress.
Gina shared a photo showing a group of women posing with a giant balloon while introducing a new fashion piece for her store.

Gina got her tattoo several years before February 8, 2023; the tattoo symbolizes freedom, specifically dancing without worrying about what other people think, and reminds Gina to follow her passions and express herself.
Jon said that dance gives Jon an escape to be himself and supports expressing oneself freely without worrying about other people's opinions.
Jon shared a photo of a woman in a tutu posing for a picture.

Gina believes dancing allows people to be themselves and that the feeling produced by dancing is uniquely powerful; Gina finds Jon's dedication to his dance studio inspiring and encourages Jon to pursue his dreams.
Jon told Gina that dance is Jon's passion and that Jon intends to keep working hard to make Jon's dance studio and business ventures successful.
Jon shared a photo of a trophy topped with a glass globe.

Jon said balancing dancing and running a business is difficult but rewarding. Jon's dance work gives Jon energy to tackle business goals, while business successes increase Jon's motivation on the dance floor; Jon views the balance as challenging but fun.

Gina actively encourages Jon's dance and business ambitions, tells Jon not to stop dreaming, and says Gina will continue supporting Jon. Jon told Gina that Gina's pep talks and ongoing support mean a great deal and that Jon is grateful to have Gina in Jon's corner.
Gina and Jon agreed to keep moving forward while chasing their dreams and helping each other.

On 2023-03-16, Jon told Gina that life had been hectic because he had started going to the gym during the preceding week to stay on track with his venture, and he was trying to balance everything while feeling that things were going well.
On 2023-03-16, Gina told Jon that she had been going through tough times after losing her job at DoorDash.
On 2023-03-16, Gina told Jon that despite the hardship caused by losing her DoorDash job, she had some good news to share, but she did not yet reveal what the news was.

On 2023-03-16, Jon expressed sympathy about Gina's difficulties, asked what was wrong, and offered to help; after Gina mentioned good news, Jon responded enthusiastically and said he could not wait to hear it.
On 2023-03-16, Gina announced that her online clothing store had opened after she had dreamed about it for a long time; she shared a photo of a computer screen displaying a book and a pair of shoes.
Gina said she started her online clothing store because she is passionate about fashion trends and finding unique pieces, and she wanted to combine her love of dance with fashion.
Jon congratulated Gina on opening her online clothing store and asked what inspired her to start it.
Jon praised Gina for combining dance and fashion in her store, wished her success, and shared a photo of three young girls standing next to each other with trophies.
Gina asked Jon how his business was going and said she hoped it was going well.

Jon said losing his job had been hard, but he was now living his dreams. He said starting his business had been difficult, that he faced new challenges, and that he was determined to succeed; he shared a photo of a laptop computer on a table.
Gina said running her own business had had ups and downs but had been an amazing ride.
Jon said Gina's success and determination inspired him to keep pushing forward.
Jon and Gina identified with each other's challenges as entrepreneurs and described their mutual support as being like having a partner to dance with.
Gina and Jon said they were pursuing different paths but could root for and support each other, and Gina expressed confidence that they could succeed.
Jon and Gina agreed to keep supporting each other, continue pursuing their dreams, and celebrate their achievements while working toward success together.
Jon thanked Gina for having his back, toasted their future success and the challenges ahead, and shared a photo of two champagne glasses with a wine bottle in the background.
On March 23, 2023, Gina told Jon that her online clothing store had been a roller coaster but rewarding, and that starting a business took courage; Gina encouraged Jon to persevere with his business.
On March 23, 2023, Jon told Gina that pursuing his business had been tough but that he was going to make it happen; Jon praised Gina for being awesome with her store and asked how it was going.

As of March 23, 2023, Gina's online clothing store was doing well, though operating it required a lot of work. Gina was keeping up with fashion trends so she could offer customers the best pieces, and she was enjoying the work.
Gina asked Jon for advice or tips on running a successful business.
On 2023-03-23, Jon advised Gina that strong brand identity, customer relationships, showing customers that she cares, positivity, and motivating others are important for her online clothing store.

On 2023-03-23, Gina said she was continually working on building customer relationships and creating a strong brand image for her online clothing store, and agreed that staying positive was important.
Jon said that seeing his dance students succeed and helping them learn and reach their goals motivates him in his dance studio business.
On 2023-03-23, Jon shared a photograph taken after a dance class showing a group of women performing a dance routine.

On 2023-03-23, Jon expressed that Gina's support and help with staying motivated had made a huge difference to him and meant a lot in his dance-business journey; Gina repeatedly encouraged him, said she was rooting for him, and urged him never to give up.

Gina viewed supporting Jon's dreams as something positive and worthwhile, while Jon felt grateful for Gina's encouragement and said her words motivated him to continue believing in himself and not quit.

On April 3, 2023, Jon told Gina that Jon had shut down his bank account because he believed the difficult decision would help Jon's dance-studio business grow. Jon said handling the changes had been hard, but Jon was staying positive and looking ahead.

On April 3, 2023, Gina said Gina was running new offers and promotions for Gina's online clothing store to attract new customers. Gina described starting the business as a wild ride but said Gina was not giving up.
Gina uses dance as stress relief, while fashion fuels Gina's creativity; finding new fashion trends for Gina's online clothing store helps Gina stay motivated to keep growing.
On April 3, 2023, Gina shared a photo of Gina's favorite dance session showing one man and one woman performing a yoga pose.

Gina combines Gina's clothing business with dance because Gina is passionate about both, wants to express creativity and share that love with others, and can add dance-inspired items to Gina's online store.

By April 3, 2023, Gina's new offers and promotions had increased sales because customers liked them. Customers also appeared to like Gina's designs, and Gina was continually searching for unique, trendy pieces. Growing Gina's customer base was Gina's main current focus.

Over the next few months after April 3, 2023, Gina planned to work with fashion bloggers and influencers and run more advertisements to attract attention, expand Gina's customer base, and make Gina's online clothing store a top destination for fashion fans.
On April 3, 2023, Jon said Jon was expanding Jon's dance studio's social-media presence and offering workshops and classes to local schools and community centers.

Jon planned to host a dance competition in May 2023 to showcase local talent and bring more attention to Jon's dance studio. Jon said the studio's work was producing progress and making the dancers excited, and Jon valued providing a place where people could express themselves through dance.
On April 3, 2023, Jon shared a photo related to the upcoming event showing a group of people on a stage with a projector screen.
Jon invited Gina to attend Jon's dance event in May 2023, and Gina said Gina would like to join and show support.
Jon's May 2023 dance event will feature Jon's dance studio and other schools presenting performances, with dancers showcasing their best moves in an evening of creative, fun performances and judging.
On April 3, 2023, Jon shared a photo of the planned dance event showing a group of dancers on a stage with one man standing in the middle of the group.
Gina praised Jon's studio expansion and progress, and Jon said Gina's backing and encouragement helped Jon continue trying to make Jon's business plan work despite difficulties.
Gina confirmed that she plans to attend and support Jon's dance show/event in May 2023.
Gina shared a photo of a woman wearing a tutu and posing for a picture.
Jon shared a photo of two women doing a handstand in a room.
Gina shared a photo of a group of young girls wearing tutus and ballet shoes.
Jon wished Gina good luck with Gina's online clothing store.
Gina shared a photo of a dress with a sign reading "june bunty" on it.
Jon told Gina that Jon is always there for Gina, and Gina said Jon's support means a lot to Gina.
Gina expressed determination to keep pursuing Gina's goals and encouraged Jon to pursue Jon's goals as well.
Jon said that Jon will not quit on Jon's dreams and that Gina's words motivate Jon.
Jon shared a photo of a street light on a sidewalk in front of a building.
Gina encouraged Jon to believe in himself, keep pushing, and take care as they ended their conversation.
On April 9, 2023, Jon said he was turning his love of dance into a business, spending extensive time at his dance studio, learning alongside his students, and seeing the students excel.
On April 9, 2023, Jon shared a photo showing a group of dancers performing on a stage with a red background.
On April 9, 2023, Gina praised Jon for turning his passion into a business and said the dance studio looked awesome.
On April 9, 2023, Gina shared a photo showing a dress display and a flamingo.
Jon said that losing his job was difficult but pushed him to pursue dance and build the studio he loves.
On April 9, 2023, Gina encouraged Jon, saying difficult times can lead to positive opportunities and praising his courage to pursue his dreams.
On April 9, 2023, Gina shared a photo of a red dress with gold accents displayed on a mannequin.
Jon said dance makes him very happy, allows him to live as his true self, and gives him joy through helping his students improve.
On April 9, 2023, Jon shared a photo showing a woman pole dancing in a dance studio; Gina interpreted the image as showing Jon looking happy while dancing.
Jon said dancing is a way for him to express himself and find his happy place. He used to fear other people's opinions, but now believes his own happiness matters most.
Gina remembered taking dance classes and enjoying time in the studio; she said the dance photo brought back many memories and was glad dance remained Jon's happy place.
On April 9, 2023, Gina shared a photo showing a group of young women dressed in ballet attire.
Jon said he loved taking dance lessons with his friends when he was younger, considers those memories precious, and is glad he can continue dancing through his own studio.
Jon told Gina that dance has special meaning for both Jon and Gina, serving as a shared way for them to express themselves.
Jon thanked Gina for always being there for him, and Gina affirmed that she supported Jon and had his back.
On April 9, 2023, Gina shared a photo of one of her dance-contest trophies, featuring a glass globe on top. She described it as a reminder of the hard work, dedication, and joy involved in dance.
On April 9, 2023, Jon thanked Gina for her support of his dance studio and said it meant a lot to him.
On April 9, 2023, Gina told Jon that he had earned the praise for his hard work and encouraged him to continue.
On April 9, 2023, Jon committed to continuing to push himself and work hard, refusing to let anything hold him back as he develops his dance studio.
On April 9, 2023, Gina encouraged Jon by saying he was almost there and should keep going.

On 2023-04-24, Jon attended a fair to showcase his dance studio. He found the event stressful but rewarding, obtained several possible business leads, and learned that running the business is difficult and that self-confidence is important to success.
On 2023-04-25, Jon shared a photo showing a group of women performing a dance on a stage, apparently related to showcasing his dance studio at the fair.
By 2023-04-25, Gina had started her own online clothing store not long before that date and shared a photo of a laptop displaying a sale advertisement for the store.
Gina said she started her online clothing store after losing her job because she wanted to control her own destiny. Gina described the journey as difficult but rewarding.

Gina believes challenges are opportunities for learning and growth. To stay motivated, Gina focuses on her big goal and reasons for pursuing it, seeks help from supportive people, and dances to cope and recharge.

On 2023-04-25, Jon told Gina that he was having trouble with his dance-business project and was feeling low in confidence, making it hard for him to run the business because he lacked faith in himself.

Gina believes business confidence can be maintained by remembering past successes and progress, relying on a strong support system, and focusing on the love and purpose that motivated the business. Gina expressed faith in Jon's abilities and encouraged him to believe in himself.
On 2023-04-25, Jon accepted Gina's advice, saying he would focus on success and on why he started his dance business because he loves it; Jon believed this would help him maintain confidence.

Jon and Gina regularly encourage and support each other in pursuing their independent business dreams. On 2023-04-25, Gina told Jon he was talented and passionate about dance, urged him to tackle obstacles and keep shining, and said they were in it together; Jon promised to keep pursuing his dreams and said they would continue pushing each other forward.
On 2023-05-11, Jon said that his dance studio was still progressing and that things were looking up; Jon shared a photo showing a woman wearing a short skirt with her hands on her hips.
Jon said that losing his job pushed him to start his dream business, his own dance studio, and that he is stepping into the unknown while hoping for the best.
Gina believes Jon's determination, drive, and positive outlook will make Jon's dance studio a huge success, and Gina encouraged Jon to keep going.
Jon loves dance and said that dance has been his stress-buster since childhood; dancing helps Jon de-stress, makes Jon feel most alive, and is essential in Jon's life.
Gina uses dance as a stress fix and said that her worries vanish when she starts dancing; Gina views dance as essential to her life and cannot imagine life without it.
Jon said that dancing is second nature to Jon, and that owning a dance studio and teaching other people allows Jon to live his dream.
Jon wants Jon's dance studio to provide a place where people can dance and express themselves, a dream Jon has had for a long time.
Gina believes that giving people a place to express themselves through dance is important and that Jon's studio will make a major difference and inspire many people.
Jon told Gina that Gina's help means a lot to Jon, and Jon promised to keep Gina updated about the dance studio's progress; Gina consistently encouraged Jon's entrepreneurial dream.
Gina had an interview for a design internship on May 10, 2023; Gina thought the interview was very cool and said it went great.
Gina appreciates Jon keeping her updated about Jon's dance studio project and is eager to hear more and watch the project come to life.
Jon believes that although taking a risk and following his dreams is scary, following his dreams will pay off in the end.
On May 11, 2023, Jon said that practicing dance routines has been helping him keep his mind focused and motivated.
Gina believes dancing is excellent for maintaining focus and expressed interest in watching one of Jon's dance routines.
Jon agreed to send Gina a video of one of his dance routines when Gina has time, and Gina agreed to watch the video.
Gina told Jon that she was proud of him and was eager to see his dance routine video; Jon said Gina's help means a lot to him.

As of 2023-05-11, Jon is practicing dance routines to stay focused and motivated. Jon plans to send Gina a video of one of his routines when Gina has time. Gina wants to watch the video, is proud of Jon, and continues to offer him support. Jon values Gina's help.
On 2023-05-27, Gina told Jon that Gina had been accepted for a part-time fashion internship in the fashion department of an international company.
Gina feels both excited and nervous about starting the part-time fashion internship because it will be a major change; Gina intends to stay upbeat and learn as much as possible about fashion.
On 2023-05-27, Gina shared a photo showing a laptop computer with a logo on its screen while discussing Gina's fashion internship.
On 2023-05-27, Jon congratulated Gina enthusiastically on being accepted for the fashion internship and asked where the internship would take place and how Gina felt about it.
On 2023-05-27, Jon asked Gina about Gina's future plans and shared a photo showing a book with a yellow and green cover.
Gina plans to approach the fashion internship with an upbeat attitude and learn as much as possible.
On 2023-05-27, Jon was reading the book "The Lean Startup" to get tips for his business and considered applying its ideas to his dance studio.
On 2023-05-27, Jon believed that building a focused, efficient business and adapting based on customer feedback were important principles from "The Lean Startup".
On 2023-05-27, Jon planned to try focused business practices and customer-feedback-based adjustments in his dance studio business.
On 2023-05-27, Jon shared a photo of a whiteboard containing a list of dates related to his business ideas and milestones.
On 2023-05-27, Jon used a whiteboard to track business ideas and milestones, visualize his progress, and stay organized.
On 2023-05-27, Jon was wrapping up his business plan and looking for investors for his dance studio project.
On 2023-05-27, Jon felt driven by his passion for the dance studio project and his belief that it would succeed.
On 2023-05-27, Jon said that searching for investors had been difficult, but he remained hopeful and was learning a great deal from the process.
On 2023-05-27, Jon expressed determination to continue working on his project, keep learning and growing, and never quit despite fundraising challenges.
On 2023-05-27, Jon shared a photo of a pink sign bearing an unspecified message.
Gina encourages Jon to continue developing his dance studio business, acknowledging that obstacles are inevitable and expressing confidence that Jon can accomplish awesome things.
Jon thanked Gina for her encouraging words and said that they mean a lot to him. Jon stated that he will not let anything get him down while pursuing his dance studio business.
On 2023-06-13, Jon told Gina that he was preparing for his dance studio more than ever and thanked her for supporting and believing in him.
On 2023-06-13, Gina said she had developed a video presentation teaching people how to style her fashion pieces and planned to send the presentation to Jon later.
On 2023-06-13, Gina shared a photo of a group of young girls wearing blue outfits and posing for a picture.

On 2023-06-13, Jon said that working with young dancers had been inspiring because of their passion and commitment. Jon described opening the dance studio as a great experience and wanted it to be a place offering support and encouragement to all dancers.
On 2023-06-13, Jon said his dance studio would offer dance classes, workshops, one-on-one mentoring, and training to help dancers reach their full potential.
On 2023-06-13, Gina said she had received mentoring while learning to dance and agreed that guidance and support could help dancers achieve their goals.
On 2023-06-13, Gina shared a photo showing a skeleton and a trophy on a black cloth.
On 2023-06-13, Gina shared a photo of a group of people participating in a dance class.
On 2023-06-13, Jon shared a photo of a clipboard with a notepad attached to it.
On 2023-06-13, Gina asked Jon how he had been using the clipboard and notepad.
Jon uses a notebook with a calendar to stay organized and motivated; he uses it to set goals, track achievements, and identify areas for improvement.
Jon also uses a whiteboard to stay on track, visualize goals, and tokenize successes, which helps him remain motivated and focused.
Jon shared a photo showing a notebook with a calendar on it.
Jon shared a photo showing a group of markers sitting on top of a white surface, representing his whiteboard planning system.
Gina said that Jon's organizational system was really cool and that being organized is key to getting things done.

As of 2023-06-13, Gina is developing a video presentation teaching how to style her fashion pieces and plans to send it to Jon. Gina previously learned dance with help from a mentor and supports Jon's dance studio. Jon is preparing intensively for the studio, which he wants to be supportive and encouraging; it offers classes, workshops, one-on-one mentoring, and training. Jon color-codes his achievements on his clipboard or tracking system so he can easily monitor his progress and stay motivated.
Gina thinks color-coding is a great way to track progress and stay motivated, and she encouraged Jon to keep it up.
Gina shared a photo of a corkboard displaying pictures and words.
Jon said his color-coded tracking system helps him stay motivated and reminds him why he is pursuing his current goals.
On June 13, 2023, Gina shared a photo of a person holding a paper bag featuring an image of a bird and a birdie after agreeing that Jon's idea was great.
On June 13, 2023, Gina told Jon that staying positive is very important and encouraged Jon with the phrase “Rock on!”
On June 13, 2023, Gina shared a photo of a quote printed on a white sheet with a rainbow of light.
On June 13, 2023, Jon thanked Gina and said that Gina's support had been really awesome.
On June 13, 2023, Gina encouraged Jon to keep pursuing his dreams and not quit.
On June 13, 2023, Jon told Gina that Jon would not give up and would keep pushing and working to make Jon's dreams happen.
On 2023-06-15, Jon received mentoring from an inspiring businessperson, which increased Jon's motivation to pursue his dreams.

As of 2023-06-16, Jon was promoting his business and described the experience as a challenging, unpredictable ride while continuing to persevere.
Gina advised Jon to market his business through social media and collaborations with influencers to expand his reach.
By 2023-06-16, Jon had begun using social media marketing and posted dance videos online; Jon said the videos were creating a stir.
Gina responded positively to Jon's online dance videos and encouraged Jon to continue.
Gina became an entrepreneur after losing her job and opened an online clothing store. Gina said the store had been successful and that being her own boss while doing work she loves was rewarding.
Gina considers becoming an entrepreneur after losing her job a huge but worthwhile leap.
Gina advised people starting a business to remain passionate, focused, resilient, self-confident, open to learning, and committed to continuous improvement despite challenges.
Jon accepted Gina's advice that resilience and focus are essential for entrepreneurs and stated that Jon would not quit; Gina's encouragement motivated Jon to continue.
Gina told Jon that failures bring a person closer to success and encouraged Jon not to give up.
On 2023-06-16, Gina shared a photo from her dancing experience, describing dancing as a difficult journey that was ultimately worth it. The photo showed a group of young women posing together.
On 2023-06-16, Jon praised Gina's shared photo of young women dancing, saying the group looked great and passionate about dancing and that the photo reminded Jon how much Jon loves performing.
On 2023-06-16, Gina was glad that the shared dancing photo reminded Jon of Jon's love for dancing and encouraged Jon to pursue Jon's dreams.
On 2023-06-16, Jon told Gina that Gina's help meant a lot to Jon and that Jon was not giving up.
